name: Superblog
tagline: SEO-focused hosted blogging platform with API and MCP access.
shortDescription: A hosted blog CMS for companies that want fast pages, SEO automation, and AI-assisted content operations.
agentSummary: Superblog is useful for agents that need to draft, publish, schedule, and manage blog posts, categories, tags, and internal-link suggestions through its documented API and remote HTTP MCP server. It is best treated as a production content system: use authenticated, scoped access and human review for public posts, SEO metadata, domains, and team settings.
bestFor: Publishing and maintaining SEO-oriented company blogs from agent workflows.
cautionNotes: Agents can publish or alter public-facing content, categories, tags, and schedules. Superblog's MCP access requires the SUPER plan, and production blog, domain, SEO, analytics, team, and billing settings should be reviewed by a human before broad automation.
pricingSummary: Public pricing page advertises a 7-day free trial with no credit card, cancellation anytime, and a 30-day money-back policy; MCP docs state MCP requires the SUPER plan.
authModel: Dashboard login is account-based; MCP is configured as an authenticated remote HTTP server at write.superblog.ai, and API access is documented through the Superblog API reference.
accountCreation: Self-serve signup is available from the Superblog website with a 7-day trial and no credit card required.
browserSupport: The Superblog dashboard and editor are web apps, so browser automation can help with review or setup gaps after login.

capabilities.detail: No dedicated Superblog CLI package was found; the docs show adding the remote MCP server through an MCP-capable client such as Claude.
Superblog documents an OpenAPI-compliant API reference and states dashboard actions are exposed as endpoints.
Official docs provide a remote HTTP MCP server endpoint for AI clients and list blog, post, category, tag, scheduling, and internal-link actions.
Superblog exposes a web dashboard, post editor, and settings areas for browser-based operation after login.
The homepage and pricing page link to self-serve signup and advertise a 7-day trial with no credit card required.
The public pricing page documents trial, cancellation, and refund terms, while MCP docs separately state the SUPER plan is required for MCP.
Docs include setup articles for account creation, the dashboard, editor, API, MCP, and many operational FAQs.
Superblog offers a no-credit-card trial for testing, but the public docs do not describe a separate sandbox, test mode, or local development mode.
